source.material: Three adult friends share a café table. One recounts a small everyday mishap while another responds. The third person remains part of the gathering without leaving or changing seats.

source_abstraction.premise: Three companions sit together around a café table as a narrative about a minor daily misadventure is shared and received.
source_abstraction.interaction_arc: One companion begins recounting an amusing mishap to the group. A second companion leans in to offer a spoken reaction, while the third companion listens attentively from their seat. The group shares a moment of collective engagement as the anecdote concludes.

subjects.appearance: Mustard-yellow knit sweater and a high curly dark hair bun
Forest-green corduroy jacket and round wire-rimmed glasses
Cobalt-blue button-down shirt and shoulder-length silver hair

shots.beat: A sets down a ceramic mug and gestures animatedly with both hands while recounting a misplaced set of keys. B tilts forward with an amused grin, while C rests both forearms against the tabletop and smiles warmly.
A raises both hands to mime frantically digging through a tote bag, laughing aloud. B leans in closer over the table, chuckling and adjusting wire-rimmed glasses.
A taps index fingers on the wooden table while delivering the conclusion of the story. B nods in shared amusement, resting a chin against one palm.

shots.content: In a quiet café seating area, the person in the mustard-yellow knit sweater and high curly dark hair bun sits at the window-side seat nearest the tall floor plant, setting down a ceramic mug and gesturing animatedly with both hands while recounting a misplaced set of keys. The person in the forest-green corduroy jacket and round wire-rimmed glasses occupies the window-side seat nearest the café counter, tilting forward with an amused grin, while the person in the cobalt-blue button-down shirt and shoulder-length silver hair sits at the short-end seat directly in front of the tall floor plant, resting both forearms against the tabletop and smiling warmly.

The person in the mustard-yellow sweater raises both hands to mime frantically digging through a tote bag, laughing aloud. The person in the forest-green jacket leans in closer over the table, chuckling and adjusting wire-rimmed glasses.

The person in the mustard-yellow sweater taps index fingers on the wooden table while delivering the conclusion of the story. The person in the forest-green jacket nods in shared amusement, resting a chin against one palm.
